S1.3 and S5.3 depend on interpreter speed for a large init (undo-tree alone took ~25 min in the Doc 40 audit); compilation is owned by another session, so those two may stay red on that dependency and must not be weakened.  Count 14 -> 15.
** S1.3 The user's real init.el (~/.emacs.d) loads under the image without errors in a bounded time
** S3.1 GUI backend chosen and recorded (design doc with an independent audit)
** S3.2 A GUI frame opens, renders text with faces through a real font rasterizer, cursor and mode line
** S3.3 Pixel metrics: window-text-pixel-size, line height, char width, fringes and margins consistent with the renderer
** S4.1 Keyboard: modifiers, key repeat and Japanese input through the user's SKK (ddskk running inside nemacs; text lands in the buffer) reach the command loop
** S4.2 Mouse: clicks, drag, wheel, hit testing to buffer positions; menu bar and context menus
** S4.3 Clipboard and primary selection interoperate with other applications
** S5.1 End to end under Xvfb with -Q: open, edit, search, split, mouse select, copy/paste, save, quit
** S5.3 End to end under Xvfb with the user's init.el (evil, SKK): the S5.1 scenario plus Japanese input via SKK
** S5.2 Real packages in the GUI: dired, magit status, org agenda open and render without errors
